title: Stray spaces and TRIM
objective: Use TRIM to remove leading, trailing and doubled spaces, then look up each region's sales target.
instructions: Region names in column A were copied from different files and some have extra spaces. Column D shows how many characters were typed, and column E shows what a lookup finds without cleaning. In B2:B7, clean each region name with TRIM. In C2:C7, look up the clean name in column B in the target list in G1:H7 with XLOOKUP and show the text "Not found" when there is no match. Fix the target list with $ signs.
hints: TRIM(text) removes spaces at the start and the end of the text, and reduces any run of spaces inside the text to a single space. =TRIM(A2) cleans the name in A2.
Look up the cleaned name in column B, not the raw name in column A: =XLOOKUP(B2,$G$2:$G$7,$H$2:$H$7,"Not found").
Compare column E with column C. A lookup on the raw text fails because "Nairobi " (with a space) is not the same text as "Nairobi".
